 burger menu Latest. Confirmed line-up: Miley and Willock in for Gunners game
 Published 3 hours ago Team Men Matthias Jaissle has made two changes to the Newcastle United starting XI for their Premier League clash with Arsenal (kick-off 5.30pm GMT). 
 Dan King Written by
 Lewis Miley and Joe Willock come in for Nico González and Yoane Wissa in the two tweaks to the team which started against Fulham last time out.
 That means Willock starts against his former club; he progressed through the Hale End academy and made 78 appearances in all competitions scoring 11 times, before joining the Magpies, initially on loan, in February 2021. This will be his 175th appearance for Newcastle and his 100th Premier League start in black and white.
 Dan Burn, meanwhile, captains the side on his 200th appearance for his boyhood club. He starts in defence alongside Malick Thiaw, with Amar Dedić and Lewis Hall at full-back. Lukáš Horníček continues in goal.
 Willock and Miley join Sean Steur in midfield while Harvey Barnes - whose next goal will be the 100th of his senior career - and Jacob Murphy support main striker William Osula. 
 Jacob Ramsey is back from suspension and among the substitutes. Tino Livramento, Sven Botman, Fabian Schär, Nico González, Yoane Wissa, Anthony Elanga and Matias Fernandez-Pardo are also on the bench, with Nick Pope the back-up goalkeeper.
 Newcastle United: Lukáš Horníček, Lewis Hall, William Osula, Harvey Barnes, Malick Thiaw, Sean Steur, Jacob Murphy, Joe Willock, Dan Burn (c), Amar Dedić, Lewis Miley 
 Substitutes: Nick Pope, Tino Livramento, Sven Botman, Fabian Schär, Nico González, Yoane Wissa, Anthony Elanga, Matias Fernandez-Pardo, Jacob Ramsey
